context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: （株）/小生/亭/竹中/ニッポン放送/世田谷/キャピタル/人組

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、我が（株）の歴史、語ろうか。
lines.en: Ren, shall I tell you the history of our company?
lines.style: Warm opening, settling into memory. Slow, measured pace. The ease of someone who has earned the right to tell this story. Slight emphasis on 'our'—inviting him in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、是非。小生のような後輩には貴重な機会です。
lines.en: Yes, please. This is a precious opportunity for a junior like me.
lines.style: Earnest and slightly formal. Careful attention in every word. No rush. The eagerness of someone genuinely honored, not performing it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業期、社員みんなで九段亭に集まったよ。
lines.en: In the founding days, all of us gathered at Kudan-tei.
lines.style: Drifting into the past. Warm, almost tender. Slowing on 'Kudan-tei.' The voice of someone seeing the room clearly in his mind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 創業者の竹中さん、ニッポン放送のラジオ番組にも出演されていたとか。
lines.en: Founder Takenaka even appeared on a Nippon-Hoso radio program, I've heard.
lines.style: Searching, curious inflection at the end. Leaning forward slightly. Testing whether he has the story right, wanting confirmation from the source.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん。世田谷の本社、当時は小さな建物だった。
lines.en: He did. Our Setagaya headquarters was just a small building back then.
lines.style: Affirming gently. Slight pause before the location name. The voice of someone looking at an old photograph. Soft, almost wistful.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 初期キャピタル、3人組の発起人で集めたんですか。
lines.en: Did the three founders raise the initial capital together?
lines.style: Careful probing. Respectful but direct. The question of someone taking notes internally, wanting to understand the mechanics of how it was done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: そう。粘り強さが、今の礎だ。
lines.en: They did. Tenacity—that's what built the foundation we stand on today.
lines.style: Firm, grounded. Light weight on 'tenacity.' Not a lecture—a quiet piece of wisdom, offered. The closing line of someone who has said what matters.
